S3 lifecycle/archive/protection

Infinitely scalable object storage and intelligent cost management.

1. Core Concept

  • S3 stores flat files (objects). To save money, move infrequently accessed objects to cheaper tiers using Lifecycle Rules. To prevent deletion, use Object Lock.

2. Key Services & Features

  • S3 Storage Classes:
    • Standard: Millisecond access, highly durable.
    • Standard-IA: Cheaper storage, but charges for retrieval. Min 30 days.
    • Glacier Flexible: Minutes to hours retrieval, extremely cheap.
    • Glacier Deep Archive: 12-48 hours retrieval, lowest cost.
    • Intelligent-Tiering: Moves objects automatically based on access patterns (small monitoring fee).
  • Object Lock & Versioning:
    • Versioning keeps all modifications of an object.
    • Object Lock writes data as WORM (Write Once Read Many).
    • Compliance Mode means NO ONE (not even root) can delete it until the date passes.

3. Architecture Rules

  • If access patterns are completely unknown, default to S3 Intelligent-Tiering.
  • Lifecycle rules cascade downwards: Standard -> IA -> Glacier. You cannot go backwards automatically.

4. Scenarios & Use Cases

  • Compliance laws require audit logs to be retained for 7 years and absolutely immune to deletion.
    • Choose: S3 Glacier with Object Lock in Compliance Mode.
    • Why: It enforces mathematical immutability that satisfies strict regulatory WORM requirements.
  • You have petabytes of data, some accessed daily, some never, and you don't know which is which.
    • Choose: S3 Intelligent-Tiering.
    • Why: It automates the lifecycle transitions based on actual usage without retrieval fees.
